evidence: Synthetic engineering screen to compare the existing 2 mm shifted 1310 nm Ports. No measured product/CAD geometry, optical keepout map, support drawing, or assembly tolerance supplied.
search_aperture_policy: Clip each generated 4w half-aperture to the declared per-axis cap, then apply the original cumulative Gaussian-tail guard. Archived R6 apertures are replayed unchanged.

rationale.volume: Nominal compact review window for the 2 mm X/Z Port displacement, with 1.15 mm longitudinal overhang on each side. This is a scenario, not a customer package spec.
rationale.aperture_and_clearance: 2.2 mm per-axis clear-opening cap, quadratic patch AABB thickened behind the illuminated normal by 0.15 mm and padded by 0.05 mm, 0.05 mm declared AABB clearance.
rationale.margin: Reserve 10 percent of the 0.15 footprint-curvature limit and 5 mrad below the 0.1 rad post-mirror divergence limit. Report fixed Glass Port divergence separately.
rationale.overlap: 0.99 minimum normalized scalar Gaussian overlap for comparing screening candidates. Actual total coupling and production yield are Uncomputed.
